cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(tower_transmog LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreadedDLL")
add_compile_definitions(_ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL=0)
add_compile_options(/utf-8)
set(FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_MINHOOK "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/minhook")
set(FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_PATTERN16 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/pattern16")
set(FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_SPDLOG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/spdlog")
set(ER_WITH_HOOKS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(deps/elden-x)
if(NOT EXISTS "${STEAMWORKS_ROOT}/include/steam/steam_api.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "STEAMWORKS_ROOT must contain the Steamworks 1.59 headers and import library")
endif()
add_library(tower_transmog SHARED src/tower_bridge.cpp src/ertransmogrify_local_player.cpp src/ertransmogrify_vfx.cpp src/ertransmogrify_net.cpp src/utils/players.cpp)
target_include_directories(tower_transmog PRIVATE "${STEAMWORKS_ROOT}/include")
target_link_libraries(tower_transmog PRIVATE elden-x "${STEAMWORKS_ROOT}/lib/steam/steam_api64.lib")
